records.title: Federal Law 303-FZ amends the Budget Code: digital-ruble budget payments pilot from October, then any federal payment — pensions, scholarships, state salaries — from January 1, 2026 …
records.text: Federal Law 303-FZ amends the Budget Code: digital-ruble budget payments pilot from October, then any federal payment — pensions, scholarships, state salaries — from January 1, 2026, through a Federal Treasury digital-ruble account. The state ledger wins its first real user the same way Korea's would: by paying the people who can't say no.

records.title: Putin signs the mass-rollout law: systemically important banks and large merchants must handle digital rubles and the universal QR code from September 1, 2026, the rest by 2028.
records.text: Putin signs the mass-rollout law: systemically important banks and large merchants must handle digital rubles and the universal QR code from September 1, 2026, the rest by 2028. Nobody asked the banks whether they preferred stablecoins. The one retail CBDC that can't be paused by a committee is the one imposed by decree.
kv: Putin Makes the Digital Ruble Mandatory

kv: Bloomberg: the Bank and Treasury are discussing converting this summer's promised go/no-go on the digital pound into a suspension — internal research shows the benefit of a retail CBDC shrinking while banks prove out tokenized deposits. Another retail state ledger quietly dies in committee.

records.title: Reading 2 of 3
kv: HM Treasury awards HSBC Orion the platform mandate for DIGIT, the pilot digital gilt — on track to be the first G7 sovereign bond issued on a distributed ledger. Britain shelves the digital pound and tokenizes the debt instead. The state ledger that survives is the one that holds the borrowing.
